specs.label: Switcher
specs.value: 8x2 auto-switching or manual, audio-follows-video, Crestron Auto-Locking® and QuickSwitch HD™ technologies

specs.label: Input Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI with HDR10, HDR10+, and Dolby Vision support, Deep Color support, and 4K60 4:4:4 support (DVI and Dual-Mode DisplayPort™ interface compatible) on Inputs 1-6, DM Essentials with Deep Color and 4K on Inputs 7-8

specs.label: Output Signal Types
specs.value: HDMI, DM Essentials, and HDBaseT with HDR10, HDR10+, and Dolby Vision pass-through support, Deep Color support, and 4K60 4:4:4 support (DVI compatible)

specs.label: Audio Inputs
specs.value: Two mono 1-channel MIC/LINE inputs; Six mono 1-channel LINE inputs; One stereo 2-channel LPCM audio extracted from the selected HDMI or DM Essentials input source

specs.label: Audio Outputs
specs.value: One mirrored HDMI 1 and DM Essentials 1 audio output; One mirrored HDMI 2 and DM Essentials 2 audio output; One AUX 1 output, stereo 2-channel; One AUX 2 output, stereo 2-channel

specs.label: Gain Range
specs.value: -10 dB to +10 dB in 1 dB increments

specs.label: Phantom Power
specs.value: +48 VDC, 12 mA, enable or disable per channel

specs.label: Audio, Line Inputs (CH3-CH8) gain range
specs.value: -10 dB to +10 dB in 1 dB increments
